question: A thin, non-conducting hemispherical shell of radius $R$ is placed with its base on the x-y plane, centered at the origin, and its dome in the $z > 0$ region. It has a non-uniform surface charge density given by $σ(θ) = σ₀ cos(θ)$, where $σ₀$ is a positive constant and $θ$ is the polar angle measured from the positive z-axis. What is the magnitude of the net electric field at the center of the base (the origin)?
